outcome_exposure.statement: The development surfaces were already open before V361. This protocol freezes one retrospective mechanism sensitivity before its execution; it cannot create a new confirmatory claim.

question: Across a frozen harm-budget path, does record-specific candidate information improve over an exact source-selected constant safe shift?

design.nested_units: records within physical cells within domains
design.primary_metric: cell-macro mean absolute error, then equal weighting of complete domains
design.pchp_selection: For every outer domain and budget, select alpha by minimum inner-domain-equal PCHP cell-macro MAE using only the other eleven domains; ties within 1e-12 choose the largest alpha.
design.control: For every candidate alpha, compute the exact weighted-median constant offset for inner-domain-equal cell-macro MAE, constrain it to [-delta, delta], then select alpha on the same eleven source domains. The control uses no raw candidate feature.

primary_estimand: Domain-equal mean of the budget-normalized trapezoidal integral of PCHP-minus-exact-safe-shift cell-macro MAE over delta in [0, 0.03]. Negative values favor PCHP.

primary_gates.majority_positive_budgets_favor_pchp: At least four of the seven positive grid budgets have negative domain-equal PCHP-minus-control MAE.
primary_gates.all_anchor_checks: At delta=0.01, the selected-alpha roster, PCHP MAE, and PCHP-minus-baseline effect reproduce V326/V327 within 1e-12.
primary_gates.all_structural_checks: Zero-budget identity, displacement and observed-regret bounds, non-increasing trajectories, and no range clipping that would invalidate the exact weighted-median shift derivation.

decision_rule.RETAIN: All primary gates pass. The manuscript may report across-budget candidate-information value as a protocol-locked retrospective mechanism sensitivity.
decision_rule.NARROW: Any primary gate fails. Do not claim across-budget candidate-information value; retain only the already frozen delta=0.01 candidate-control conclusion.

interpretation_if_not_passed: The learned candidate is not distinguished from an exact source-selected constant safe shift across the declared budget path. Retain the projection theorem and the frozen delta=0.01 result, but prohibit a broader adaptive-mechanism claim.
stop_rule: Execute this frozen script once. Code or gate changes after scientific output access require a new version and the V361 result remains in the evidence ledger.
